loading.deployment: selected pilot portraits, shared player weapons, required stage textures
loading.transition: release previous stage textures and derived caches; preserve explicitly queued copied-form dependencies
loading.quality: automatic native resolution on low-memory/low-core devices; reduce supersampling after sustained slow play frames

audioDescription: Level music and stage-specific sounds are in audio/. Common music and reusable sounds are registered in BOFA and stored once in shared/audio.
